title: Ek Hi Raasta
desc: Kubla, a terrorist, wants to rule India. He gets Vikram, an army officer, to frame Karan for murder. They kidnap Col. Choudry and his daughter.

title: Jamai Raja
desc: Siddharth, a hotelier, tries to mend the broken bond between his strong-willed wife, Roshni, and her ambitious mother, Durga Devi. His efforts lead to emotional twists and heartfelt moments.

title: Izzatdaar
desc: When Brahm Dutt, a wealthy businessman, is falsely convicted on murder charges, he enlists the help of a boy to exact revenge from Indrajeet, his cruel son-in-law and the cause of all his miseries.

title: Gharwali Baharwali
desc: Arun marries Kaajal for his father's happiness. When she can't have children, his father wants him to remarry. An affair threatens their family.

title: Swarg
desc: Kumar loses everything due to a rival's sabotage and family betrayal. His loyal servant Krishna becomes a star and returns to help Kumar seek revenge and rebuild.

title: Benaam Badsha
desc: A man, abandoned at birth, becomes a paid assassin and ruins Jyoti's life on her wedding day. Later, she moves in with him, determined to reform him.

title: Ishk Actually
desc: Gia's life gets complicated when her former lover, Neil, reappears. Over time, she realizes that true happiness comes from following her heart.
